name: simultaneous-interpretation
description: Desktop AI interpretation assistant for realtime bilingual captions, floating subtitles, and optional translated speech.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build
scripts.test:provider-streaming: tsx tests/providerStreaming.test.ts && tsx tests/aliyunTranslationMessages.test.ts && tsx tests/audioPayloadQueue.test.ts && tsx tests/realtimeWebSocket.test.ts && tsx tests/providerReconnect.test.ts
scripts.test:history: tsx tests/historyStorage.test.ts && tsx tests/historyGrouping.test.ts && tsx tests/historyProjection.test.ts && tsx tests/historyDeferredWriter.test.ts && tsx tests/uiPreferences.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:latency && npm run test:asr-events && npm run test:scheduler && npm run test:provider-streaming && npm run test:captions && npm run test:history && npm run test:refinement && npm run test:diagnostics && npm run test:timing-harness && npm run test:model-benchmark && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:state
scripts.start: set "PATH=%SystemRoot%\System32;%PATH%" && set "ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=" && npm run build && electron .
